forms.label: 12-bar blues
forms.note: Each verse is three lines, and each of those lines spans FOUR chord entries (4 bars), making 12 bars: I7 I7 I7 I7 | IV7 IV7 I7 I7 | V7 IV7 I7 V7 (variants welcome). Line two repeats line one, perhaps with a small change; line three answers or twists it.

5. verse 3: 3 lines, 4 chord entries per line

7. outro: instrumental, 4 chord entries, no lines
